# Security Policy — Space Tides (v0idgames)

At **v0idgames**, we prioritize player safety, account confidentiality, and the security of our distributed game clients and cloud backend services.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Latest Release (Releases Tab) | :white_check_mark: |
| Older Builds (< v0.1.0)       | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover any security flaw, exploit (e.g., authentication bypass, token interception, or unauthorized cloud storage access), please report it responsibly:

1. **Do not create a public issue.**
2. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting via the [Security Advisories](https://github.com/gmichelucci/space-tides-releases/security/advisories/new) tab.
3. Or email the lead developer directly: `gf.michelucci@gmail.com`.

We investigate all reports promptly and credit contributors in our release notes.
